The two searches agree that R above 2/3 requires a strongly nonuniform, single-dominant-peak profile rather than a flat one; the parametric route reached a higher score at finer resolution, consistent with the optimum being a smooth peaked shape that coarse step optimization only approximates. This is a reason to prefer smooth-profile parameterizations and to refine them at high N.
